candidates.eligibility_condition: At least one of the two initial displacement-L2 or energy-error slopes for TET4 is below its proposed floor, while all inputs are finite, the residual and force/moment/work-energy balances pass, and load/post-processing quadrature sensitivity passes.
candidates.mesh_rule: Generate the conforming straight-sided n=16 successor of the n=8 Cartesian-cube six-tetrahedra-per-cube mesh using the same deterministic tetrahedralization rule. Verify positive determinants, conformity, quality, exact node sharing and selected DDL <= 30000.

candidates.eligibility_condition: Relative change in integrated body-force resultant or origin moment between the two proposed rules exceeds 1e-6, with finite positive weights and valid mesh geometry. This diagnoses load integration and does not establish solution accuracy.
candidates.mesh_rule: Reuse the exact L3 mesh and compare the predeclared order-8 and order-12 load rules for the same continuous MMS body force; the FEM job is distinct from the consumed L3 case.

criteria_reference.adaptive_trigger_policy: A numerical criterion makes a candidate eligible for review only. It never starts, registers, reserves, or authorizes a candidate. Infrastructure, provenance, finiteness, or incomplete-report failures stop the campaign rather than trigger an adaptive case.

global_owner_decision.after_decision: PASS continuation and only the preapproved numerical adaptive transitions may proceed autonomously, subject to exact runner, manifest, ledger, provenance, and budget checks. Out-of-table deviations and infrastructure/provenance/ledger failures stop for review.
global_owner_decision.before_decision: No case or candidate may execute or reserve an attempt.
global_owner_decision.scope: One decision binds exact identities for all 12 initial cases, all 12 candidates in this closed adaptive catalog, source/test/runner fingerprints, exact nodeids, oracle and quadrature implementations, manifests, environment, criteria, budget, evidence destination, and conditional transition table.

identity_note: Provisional mesh bytes, SHA-256 and skipped nodeids are recorded; no source/runner fingerprint, official manifest, or approved contract exists. Final identities require review and must be bound by the Owner decision.
initial_vs_adaptive: The 12 initial mesh cases and these 12 adaptive catalog entries are separate case identities. Adaptive entries supplement the initial cases and never overwrite, retry, relabel, or replace them.
stop_rules: No retry of any reserved or consumed attempt.
No adaptation follows a provenance, infrastructure, interruption, timeout, incomplete-output, non-finiteness or invalid-geometry failure.

After the one global Owner decision, a complete PASS continues autonomously according to the approved case sequence; a numerical deviation may select only its exact preapproved catalog row and transition. Any deviation not represented in the approved table stops for review.

An adaptive eligibility signal is not permission to change identities and never expands the closed candidate set; it can select an already identified row covered by the global decision without a new per-case or per-candidate Owner decision.
All case and adaptation attempts share the campaign-wide proposed caps; no cap is borrowed from another WP12 campaign.
A mesh candidate that exceeds 30000 selected DDL or lacks verified conforming geometry is refused before any attempt reservation.

transition_rules.when: All exact initial and adaptive mesh/rule identities, nodeids, source/test/runner fingerprints, environment, criteria, budgets, destinations and transition rows are reviewed and hashed; all exact preflights are clean.

transition_rules.execution_allowed: campaign scope only after runner checks
transition_rules.when: One Owner decision binds all 12 initial cases and all 12 candidates in this closed catalog, with their exact identities and the complete conditional transition table.

transition_rules.execution_allowed: one exact attempt within the globally approved campaign
transition_rules.when: Official runner immediately validates the covered manifest, exact case identity, ledger, provenance and resource limits.
Complete attributable PASS with no adaptive trigger; continue the next case in the globally approved sequence.
A complete attributable result satisfies an exact numeric trigger in the globally approved catalog row and decision table.

transition_rules.execution_allowed: one exact adaptive attempt within the approved campaign; no additional Owner decision
transition_rules.when: Candidate is a solve-bearing case already covered by the global decision and official runner validates its manifest, registry, ledger, provenance and budget.

transition_rules.execution_allowed: one postprocessing job; zero FEM attempts and no retry
transition_rules.when: Candidate is QPOST; immutable archived state from a globally authorized case is available, exact postprocessing implementation is covered, and the controlled postprocessing time is charged to the global seconds budget.
Postprocessing report and receipt are complete and attributable to the archived state and approved rule identities.
Out-of-table deviation, infrastructure/provenance/ledger failure, timeout, interruption, non-finite required data, invalid geometry, incomplete result or exhausted caps.
